node.title: Refuted plus-only prize-admissible F2 object
node.statement: The Round-18 composite proposition applies the p=1 mod 4 order formula and bounded proportionality-class decomposition to every admissible row, and says there are exactly three generating classes. This is false on the official generating row p=2^61-1, q=p^2: ord_(2^41)(p)=2=e but the antipodal half-system has 2^40 singleton F_p-proportionality classes. The corrected classification has five signed generating types and the minus branch is one coupled negacyclic code. The field-cap, trace-rank, and coset-invariance components survive only in their corrected scopes.
